verdict.rationale: Phaser's engine source is published in a public GitHub repository (github.com/phaserjs/phaser), and a recorded npm probe shows the package is MIT-licensed, which permits reading, modifying and redistributing the full engine. A community comment critiquing the engine's internal patterns (circular dependencies) also suggests developers do dig into the source. missing for 10: first-party docs on building or forking the engine from source, explicit documentation that the whole engine (renderers, physics) is in the repo, hands-on reports of patching or forking the engine.
